review_candidates.title: Directeur des systèmes d'information/Directrice des systèmes d'information
review_candidates.description: Mission principale Le Directeur des Systèmes d'Information définit, pilote et met en œuvre la stratégie des systèmes d'information en cohérence avec les orientations stratégiques de l'entreprise. Il garantit la disponibilité, la sécurité, la performance et l'évolution du système d'information afin d'accompagner les métiers dans l'atteinte de leurs objectifs et de soutenir la transformation digitale de l'entreprise. Responsabilités principales Définition de la stratégie SI Élaborer et mettre en œuvre la stratégie des systèmes d'information en cohérence avec le plan stratégique de l'entreprise. Définir la feuille de route des projets informatiques et digitaux. Assurer une veille technologique afin d'anticiper les évolutions du marché. Gouvernance des systèmes d'information Garantir la disponibilité, la performance et la fiabilité des infrastructures et des applications. Définir les normes, référentiels et politiques de gouvernance du SI. Piloter les projets structurants de modernisation et de transformation digitale. Veiller à l'urbanisation et à l'évolution de l'architecture du système d'information. Cybersécurité et gestion des risques Définir et mettre en œuvre la politique de sécurité des systèmes d'information. Superviser les dispositifs de cybersécurité, de sauvegarde et de continuité d'activité. Veiller au respect des exigences réglementaires

review_candidates.title: Senior Sales Engineer (B2B & B2G)
review_candidates.location: Qesm El Sheikh Zaid, Al Jizah, Egypt
review_candidates.description: Position: Senior Sales Engineer – B2B & B2G  Candidate: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, technical discipline, business, or a closely related field. Experience: 3–5 Years      | Location: Egypt Contract: 12-Month       | Salary: Basic Salary + KPIs +Commissions Allowances: Transportation, fuel, communication, and representation allowances. Employment: Full-time (80% Outdoor: 20% Indoor or Remote) Language: Arabic + English (Writing and Speaking) LearnU is growing its B2B and B2G business and is looking for a Senior Sales Engineer who can turn engineering training needs into long-term commercial relationships. What you will do: • Own the B2B/B2G sales cycle from prospecting to closing and account expansion. • Sell enterprise learning solutions, engineering course bundles and subscriptions. • Engage engineering, HR/L&D, procurement and management stakeholders. • Prepare consultative proposals and lead technical/commercial presentations. • Build a predictable pipeline and deliver monthly/quarterly revenue targets. • Determine and coordinate official meetings with highly qualified clients and the direct manager to close some critical deals. • Prepare a periodic report on the progress status. • Collaborate with the direct manager to manage the customer loyalty program and discounts for your customers, facilitating customer retention. We are looking for someone who: • Has 3–5 years of B2B sales/business development experience. • Has sold technical solutions, training, SaaS, engineering services, or professional services. • Can speak confidently with engineers and business decision-makers. • Understands pipeline discipline, CRM, forecasting, and negotiation. • Is hungry for ownership, measurable results, and long-term account growth. • Has professional negotiation & presentation skills. • Has a car and a driver's license. Why LearnU? • A specialized engineering learning platform built around practical, job-relevant skills. • A broad engineering course portfolio across HVAC, BIM, electrical, civil, mechanical, water treatment, project management, and more. • An enterprise proposition designed to manage, assign, and measure employee development under one corporate account. • A role with direct impact on LearnU's next stage of B2B/B2G growth.

review_candidates.title: Senior AI Engineer
review_candidates.description: ConnectSquads , the IT Recruitment & Staff Augmentation division of Connectalents , is currently hiring " Senior AI Engineer " in Sherton, Cairo for a leading provider of advanced technology solutions across the Middle East & Africa, specializing in Cloud, Data Analytics, AI, and Digital Transformation. Job Role • Design, build, and deploy end-to-end AI/ML solutions including data preparation, modeling, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring. • Develop scalable data and ML pipelines with reproducibility and robust quality checks. • Implement and optimize machine learning models for predictive analytics and NLP use cases. • Productionize models using MLOps practices including CI/CD, model monitoring, drift detection, and retraining strategies. • Translate business objectives into ML problem statements, success metrics, and acceptance criteria. • Contribute to solution architecture decisions including data stores, compute, orchestration, observability, and security. • Mentor junior engineers, conduct code reviews, and contribute to engineering best practices. What we need • 4–6 years of hands-on experience in AI/ML Engineering and Applied Data Science. • Strong foundation in Statistics, Machine Learning, and Data Modeling. • Advanced Python programming skills. • Experience with ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Scikit-learn. • Practical experience deploying ML systems in production environments. • Strong SQL and data handling skills with structured and semi-structured data. • Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. • Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, AI, Engineering, or a related field. • Experience with LLMs / GenAI including RAG, embeddings, prompt orchestration, evaluation, and guardrails. • Experience with modern data stacks, orchestration tools, or streaming technologies. • Familiarity with security, governance, and compliance considerations for AI systems. • Client-facing or consulting experience. • Excellent Command of English Language What We Offer: • Ownership of real-world AI delivery from design to production. • A high-impact role shaping AI-powered data products and solutions. • Collaboration with multidisciplinary teams including data engineers, data scientists, and software engineers. • Competitive compensation package and growth opportunities.

review_candidates.title: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer (.Net/Angular)
review_candidates.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
review_candidates.description: What Makes Us, Us Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp! At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered. If you like what we’re saying, keep reading! WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US At SimCorp, we build products that power investment management and financial institutions worldwide. We support some of the largest financial institutions in the world to be successful by simplifying their investments, accounting and operations. Investment Operations is a product area within SimCorp’s Product Division, which delivers functionality enabling the operations users to be highly efficient. It also offers full STP and automation capability for the workflows and processes seamlessly across the product areas and the financial institutions workflows. As part of our Investment Operations Product Area, you will contribute to the development of enterprise products within this product area. You will collaborate with colleagues from Ukraine, Poland, Denmark and Germany, while gaining deep expertise in applied finance and modern software engineering practices. What You Will Be Responsible For As a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer in a self-organized Scrum team, you will: Design, implement, and maintain new features across both front-end and back-end (SOA). Take technical ownership of feature delivery, ensuring high quality, scalability, and performance. Drive automation-first approach: design, implement, and maintain E2E, API, Integration tests. Perform manual exploratory testing for complex scenarios. Define test strategies at feature/module level. Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Technical Leads, and teammates during analysis, refinement, and development. Contribute to architectural discussions and participate in technical decision-making Mentor and support less experienced engineers through pair programming, code reviews, and knowledge sharing. Drive improvements in automation, CI/CD pipelines, and development tools. Ensure adherence to engineering best practices (XP, TDD, clean code). Engage in Sprint Reviews/Demos and continuous process improvements What We Value Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field. 5+ years of professional experience with C# (.NET or .NET Framework) and Angular. Extensive experience in designing and developing enterprise applications. in.NET / C# and working knowledge of Angular. Demonstrated expertise in automation frameworks and CI/CD Solid understanding of manual testing techniques and QA best practices. Comprehensive understanding of Cloud and On-Prem infrastructures Deep knowledge of CI/CD processes and tools (Git, TeamCity, Azure DevOps). Extensive experience with Microsoft Azure and building/managing pipelines Readiness to learn APL, developing new features and debugging existing functionality, with full support from our team throughout the learning process. Solid understanding of software architecture and design patterns with experience in Domain Driven Design Familiarity with XP practices (TDD, pair programming, CI). Experience with relational databases (SQL). Proficient English communication skills (Upper-Intermediate or higher), written and spoken Ability to mentor, guide, and inspire other developers. NICE TO HAVE Experience with Azure or similar cloud platforms. Background in FinTech or capital markets. Knowledge and experience in the financial domain, fintech, derivatives (options, futures, swaps, etc.) is an advantage. Benefits Competitive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, at SimCorp, we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide an excellent work & life balance: flexible work hours, a hybrid workplace model. On top of that, we have IP sprints where you have 3 weeks per quarter you can spend on mastering your skills as well as contributing to the company development. There is never just only one route - we practice an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take. NEXT STEPS Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process. WHO WE ARE? For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 4,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds. SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to=back offering for our clients. SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.
